run_trace_replay_benchmark: run the commsTraceReplayBench CLI to replay collective communication traces and benchmark performance
replay_comms_trace: replay a collective communication trace file with warmup and multiple replay iterations
write_comm_details: write replayed communication performance metrics to a JSON file for a specific rank
extract_comms_info: convert a basic trace JSON list into commsArgs objects for trace replay
report_bench_time: report replay benchmark statistics including message size distribution and latency percentiles
